description: Test the functionality of the search bar to ensure users can locate connectors efficiently using specific keywords.
steps: Navigate to the Connectors page using the 'Connectors' tab.
Verify the visibility of the search bar identified by the stable selector [data-testid="Connector-search-box"].
Press Enter or wait for the search results to populate.
Verify that the list of connectors updates and displays only those matching the search term.
Assert that the displayed connectors contain the term 'test-connector' in their names or descriptions.
expected_results: Search results update dynamically to display only matching connectors.
No connectors are displayed if no match is found.
Search functionality works without performance degradation.
edge_cases: Empty search query returns all connectors.
Search with special characters does not break the UI.
Search with whitespace-only input does not produce unexpected results.
Search with case-insensitive terms returns expected results.
Invalid keywords return an empty result gracefully.
data_requirements: At least one connector with the name 'test-connector'.
A populated list of connectors in the system.
Valid user session with access to the Connectors page.
No active filters interfering with the search results.
Support for dynamic updates in the search feature.
dependencies: System must contain at least one connector.
The database must be reachable for query execution.
api_interactions: GET request to fetch connectors based on search query.
performance_metrics: UI responsiveness during typing in the search bar.
Memory usage while rendering search results.
accessibility_requirements: Search bar must be focusable using the Tab key.
Search results should be navigable using keyboard controls.
Text in the search bar must have sufficient contrast ratio.
Search functionality should work with screen readers.
No elements should obstruct the visibility of the search bar.
